breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the full unsymmetric bending formula including the product of inertia Iyz = 800000 mm^4 in both the numerator terms and the denominator D = Iy·Iz − Iyz². It does not ignore the product of inertia as the incomplete prompt suggested (by superposing My·z/Iy and Mz·y/Iz as though Iyz were zero). Instead, it properly applies the coupled formula matching the ground truth approach.
